$comment: Seorius-only thresholds (checks that page-inspect-core.mjs does not do). Same evidence classes as on-page-rules.json: MEASURED / LITERATURE / TREND / WEBFORGE DECISION. Nothing here is MEASURED, so every check that reads this file is advisory (notice at most), never an error.

urlQuality.note: SEO-tool heuristics for long or parameter-heavy URLs; no Google limit. Notice only.

internalLinks.note: Bands of fewer than 3 or more than 100 internal links are an SEO-tool heuristic; Google states no number. Notice only.

images.oversizedBytes.note: 500 KB is an SEO-tool heuristic. Notice only.

images.oversizedRenderRatio.note: An image whose natural width is at least twice its rendered width is listed as served larger than shown.

keywords.densityNoticePercent.note: No published Google figure; keyword stuffing is named in Google's spam policy without a number.

redirects.maxHops.note: The redirect chain view stops after 10 hops and says so; browsers give up at about 20.

linkCheck.concurrency.note: Six parallel requests at most, to stay polite to the inspected site.
